column3: Scroll even when a swipe begins on a button
column4: A vertical swipe on About, APD Settings or Cleric Grudge now scrolls even when starting on a button or link. Moving far enough prevents the underlying control from clicking; an ordinary tap continues to work. Other scroll panes and slider gestures remain unchanged.
